p1_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration Histogram missing from Source/Backend
p1_findings.description: FR-dependency-metrics requires 4 metrics (3 counters + 1 histogram). Source/ only has the 3 counters. The histogram exists in portal/Backend/src/metrics.ts but was never ported to Source/. Spec coverage drops to 75% for this FR.
p1_findings.recommendation: Port `dependencyCheckDuration` histogram from portal/Backend/src/metrics.ts to Source/Backend/src/metrics.ts. Add // Verifies: FR-dependency-metrics comment.

p1_findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.description: Vitest UI server allows remote code execution — attacker can read and execute arbitrary files. Affects Source/Frontend, portal/Backend, portal/Frontend. Blocks deployment.
p1_findings.recommendation: npm update vitest to >=3.2.6 across all affected workspaces.

p1_findings.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection (CVSS 9.8) [ESCALATE → TheGuardians]
p1_findings.description: Handlebars JS injection via AST type confusion — allows arbitrary JavaScript execution if backend renders templates from user input. 8 related CVEs. Blocks deployment. INJECTION trigger → TheGuardians required.
p1_findings.recommendation: 1) Identify if handlebars is used: npm list handlebars && grep -r handlebars Source/Backend/. 2) If yes, upgrade to >=4.7.9. 3) If no direct usage, remove transitive dependency. 4) TheGuardians review required.

p1_findings.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.description: Protobufjs arbitrary code execution if backend parses untrusted protobuf messages. Affects platform/orchestrator (deployment blocked) and portal/Backend.
p1_findings.recommendation: npm update protobufjs to >=7.5.5 in affected workspaces.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer validates only 1 of 8 plans; 7 false positives on dependency-linking
p2_findings.description: Enforcer selects only the most-recently-modified plan — 7 other plans are silently skipped. Additionally, the free-text regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ produces 7 false-positive failures against dependency-linking/requirements.md.
p2_findings.recommendation: Update enforcer to iterate all plans in Plans/. Tighten regex to match only canonical FR-\d{3,} IDs or anchored patterns to eliminate false positives.

p2_findings.title: 3 confirmed open portal/ requirements (types, seed data, tests missing)
p2_findings.description: FR-dependency-api-types: blocked_by? field missing from PATCH input types (frontend uses `as any`). FR-dependency-seed: no seed.ts; known dependency chains never inserted into store. FR-dependency-frontend-tests: DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx don't exist.
p2_findings.recommendation: 1) Add blocked_by? to PortalPatch input types. 2) Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with canonical dependency chains. 3) Write DependencySection.test.tsx and BlockedBadge.test.tsx.

p2_findings.title: FR-TMP-008 missing Verifies: traceability annotation
p2_findings.description: FR-TMP-008 (Worker Container Prerequisites) is the only FR-TMP requirement without a // Verifies: comment. All 9 others are traced.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-008 comment to the relevant code section in platform/orchestrator/lib/workflow-engine.js.

p2_findings.title: Vite server.fs.deny Bypass on Windows (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: Path traversal on Windows dev servers — attacker can read files outside intended root including source maps and secrets. Fix: upgrade vite to >=5.5.0 or >=6.4.3.

p2_findings.title: Form-data CRLF Injection (CVSS 7.5) [ESCALATE → TheGuardians if uploads unvalidated]
p2_findings.description: HTTP header injection via multipart form data with crafted filenames. Affects file upload handlers. CRLF injection trigger → TheGuardians review required if file uploads not validated.
p2_findings.recommendation: 1) Upgrade form-data to >=4.0.6. 2) Validate filenames server-side. 3) Sanitize control characters. 4) TheGuardians review if uploads exist.
p2_findings.escalation: TheGuardians (conditional — if file uploads not validated)

p2_findings.title: UUID Buffer Bounds Check Bypass (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.description: Buffer overflow if untrusted buffers passed to uuid v3/v5/v6 functions — memory corruption can lead to crash or arbitrary write. Requires major version bump from uuid@9 to uuid@11.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade uuid to >=11.1.1. Audit uuid usage to ensure untrusted buffers are never passed. Test thoroughly after major version bump.

p2_findings.title: Vitest Mocker + esbuild CORS bypass + Vite transitive vulnerabilities
p2_findings.description: esbuild dev server CORS/origin bypass (CSRF risk); vite path traversal in optimized deps; vite launch-editor NTLM hash disclosure on Windows. All dev-server-only but increase attack surface during development.
p2_findings.recommendation: Upgrade vitest to >=3.2.6 (resolves DEP-001 simultaneously). Enforce --host localhost only. Never expose dev servers.

p3_findings.title: Spec has no numbered FR-XXX IDs — traceability depends on Plan file
No requirements.md for tiered-merge-pipeline; platform/ excluded from enforcer
DebugPortalPage.tsx uses informal Verifies comment with no backing FR
React 18→19 and React Router 6→7 major version lag
QS query string parsing DoS via deeply nested inputs
Brace-expansion memory exhaustion in glob patterns
JS-YAML code execution if parsing untrusted YAML
p3_findings.recommendation: Only parse YAML from trusted files; use yaml.load() with safe schema only.

p4_findings.title: @babel/core arbitrary file read via source map comments

the_guardians.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
the_guardians.reason: CVSS 9.8 injection vulnerability in Source/Backend transitive dependency. Requires TheGuardians security review — cannot be deferred.

the_guardians.title: Form-data CRLF Injection in multipart field names
the_guardians.reason: CRLF injection via form-data multipart filenames. Conditional: if file uploads exist and are not validated, TheGuardians review required.
